dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Faint, light-grey curvilinear perimeters forming irregular 'C' and 'O' shaped structures on the mid-dorsal surface, characterized by a soft gradient transition from lighter interior zones to the dark blue-grey exterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, high-intensity punctate blobs and asymmetrical speckles concentrated primarily along the mid-dorsal ridge and upper-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Asymmetrical quadrilateral formed by connecting the centroids of four prominent light-grey markings across the mid-dorsal arc, with two primary annuli aligned horizontally in the center-top region.
